description: This Kotlin source file defines the CanvasController class, which manages interactions with a WebView for rendering and controlling a canvas in an Android application. It includes functionalities for capturing snapshots, navigating URLs, updating UI debug status, and handling WebView communication.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing a WebView-based canvas, capturing its bitmap, navigating URLs, and managing debug and state display.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebView to the controller and initializes it.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the WebView from the controller.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Sets the URL to load in the WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current URL is null (default canvas).

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Handles the WebView page finished event.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON state representing the home canvas.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG snapshot of the WebView as a Base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot in the specified format and quality as a Base64 string.
